full_page.content:
c. 1948
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten message on back of a photo by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
So glad "little Tommy" is bigger now and doing so well Thanks be to God.
Snapped to the side of the Chapel St. Felix Monastery, Nov. 4th 1947.
God bless you, Mrs. O'Flaherty. I hope you are all continuing well.
Please pardon delayed acknowledgment. Many thanks. I wanted to write you a letter: but ---!
Love and God's blessing to all. Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
"God condescends to use our powers If we don't spoil His plans by ours."
Praised be Jesus Christ.
(Father Solanus identified himself and his nephew, J. McCloskey, S.J. on the front of their picture)
Original in possession of : Mrs. Elizabeth O'Flaherty 1382 Nottingham Grosse Pte., MI. 48230
